name: Shawn Michaels
caption: Billed from San Antonio at 234 lbs; wins a non-title match over 2 Cold Scorpio on the strength of a two-and-a-half count the referee waves off as a clean three, and is previewed challenging Ric Flair for the CCW World Heavyweight Championship at that Sunday's Survivor Series '95.

name: 2 Cold Scorpio
caption: The CCW's own Intercontinental Champion as of 15 November 1995, billed from Denver at 235 lbs; loses a non-title match to Shawn Michaels but the title itself is not on the line.

name: Raven

name: Sting
caption: The CCW's own United States Champion as of 15 November 1995, billed from Venice Beach at 260 lbs; retains the title over Steve Richards, who is stipulated to leave the CCW on losing, and is previewed defending it again against Hunter Hearst-Helmsley at Survivor Series '95.
